extraction.policy_summary: The company answers 'Yes' to having an equal opportunity policy as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, with a web-link to a consolidated Business Responsibility Policies document (no further description of the policy's content is given in the surrounding text). Separately, MD&A narrative states the Company 'maintains strict adherence to its internal codes of conduct, with a clear zero-tolerance approach towards discrimination in any form.'
extraction.pwd_employee_count_details: BRSR tables report 10 total differently-abled employees (9 male, 1 female, all permanent) and 15 total differently-abled workers (1 permanent, 14 other-than-permanent, all male) for FY2025-26 -- 25 differently-abled employees+workers combined, matching the Company's stated performance line: 'Included 25 specially abled person in day to day activities giving them equal opportunity.' Separately, the MD&A narrative elsewhere states the Company supports '28 differently abled employees' (a differing figure from a non-BRSR-table source).
extraction.recruitment_details: The Company's stated FY2027 target is to 'Continue for inclusion of specially abled people at operation site, add 15 more people by FY 2027,' and reports current-year progress as 'Included 25 specially abled person in day to day activities giving them equal opportunity.'
extraction.compliance_details: The filing answers 'Yes' to both BRSR questions on whether premises/offices are accessible to differently abled employees/workers and to differently abled visitors, 'as per the requirements of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016,' and separately confirms (with web-link) an equal opportunity policy 'as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.' No quantified compliance percentage or employment-quota attainment figure is given beyond the specially-abled inclusion count/target noted under Recruitment.
